From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Subject: Performance review cadence, initial timeline + request for redlines

Team —

Attached is a first pass at the 2027 performance-review timeline and the manager comms draft. Key asks:

- Please review the timeline (sheet: "Milestones") and confirm there are no conflicts with team hiring freezes or product launches.
- Redline the manager comms doc with phrasing you think will reduce questions from ICs (tone, FAQs).
- I want a short confidential routing matrix for how escalation and sensitive compensation notes are circulated — only managers + People Ops should have access to calibration materials.

Deadlines:
- Redlines due by EOD Tue 2027-01-12
- Final calendar + Drive permissions set by Fri 2027-01-15

Notes on confidentiality: calibration packets will live in a restricted Drive folder (managers + people-ops). For cases that require exec exceptions (critical retention/exception pay), we will bcc an exec-only alias handled by the People Ops lead so the wider manager cohort doesn’t see those items.

Attachments: 2027_review_timeline.xlsx (xlsx) — includes milestone dates, calibration week, and deadlines; manager_comm_draft_v3.docx — draft messaging to managers and FAQs.

If anyone thinks we should shift the schedule earlier, speak now — I want to avoid last-minute compression during product Q1 launch weeks.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, People & Programs
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — I consolidated the decisions below and updated the Drive folder and timeline links. Final decisions:

4) Finance SLA: Marcus to coordinate a 48-hour response SLA for comp approvals.

   - Laura: finalize rubric + FAQ (due 2027-01-12)
   - Monica: finalize routing matrix + request Drive audit logs (due 2027-01-13)

Drive (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cReviewCycleDocs

Thanks — and appreciate the quick turnaround on the redlines.
